title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on the cold floor of a locked library. Dust hangs in the lamplight. You can see a desk, a bookshelf, a painting and a heavy door with a four-digit keypad. Type what you want to do, for example: examine the bookshelf.

examine.text: A heavy oak desk with a green lamp and an empty inkwell. Under the blotter you spot a small drawer with a four-digit combination lock.
Hundreds of dusty volumes fill the shelves. Four red-spined books stand out: they are shelved upside down.
Each red book has a handwritten number inked inside its cover. In shelf order they read: 2, 7, 1, 8.
The stormy seascape now hangs open on its hinge, exposing a small steel safe.
A stormy seascape in a heavy gilt frame. It hangs slightly crooked, as if it has been moved before.

move.text: The painting is already swung aside.
You swing the painting aside on a hidden hinge. Behind it is a small steel safe with a keyhole.

safe.name: steel safe

examine.text: The safe stands open. Inside lies a small card.
A small steel safe set into the wall. It has a keyhole and no dial.

safe.open_fail: The safe is locked. It has a keyhole.

drawer.name: drawer

examine.text: The drawer is open. Inside are a brass key and a folded letter.
A small drawer with a four-digit combination lock. It is locked.

drawer.open_fail: The drawer is locked. It needs a four-digit code.

lock.success: The wheels click into place and the drawer slides open. Inside are a brass key and a folded letter.
lock.fail: The wheels spin but the drawer stays locked. That is not the right code.

door.name: door

examine.text: A heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad. A red light shows that it is locked.

door.open_fail: The door will not move. The keypad light is red.

lock.success: The keypad chirps, the red light turns green and the heavy door swings open. Cool night air rushes in. You are free.
lock.fail: The keypad buzzes angrily. That is not the right code.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.take_text: You take the brass key and slip it into your pocket.

examine.text: A small brass key with a tiny engraved anchor. It looks like it would fit a keyhole.
The letter is written in a shaky hand: "The last two digits of the way out are 96."

card.name: small card
card.take_text: You take the small card from the safe.

examine.text: The card reads: "The first two digits of the way out are 40."

use_rules.text: The brass key turns with a soft click and the safe door swings open. Inside lies a small card.

hints.text: Start by examining the objects in the room: the desk, the bookshelf, the painting.
Those upside-down books look deliberate. Look at them closely.
The drawer has a four-digit lock. Something in the room may supply the digits.
The painting hangs oddly. Maybe something is behind it.
The safe has a keyhole. Did you find a key?
Have you read the letter from the drawer?
Have you read the card from the safe?
You have both halves of the exit code. Enter the full four digits on the door.
